Validations.Evidence: Kaelen opened his eyes to the sensation of cold radiating from his own limbs, a sharp contrast to the heavy warmth pooled in his chest where Maren’s hands still gripped him. The darkness around his vision was not empty; it was textured with the soft glow of the hearth and the faint, bruised violet pulse that bled through the stone walls from the barrier. He tried to sit up, but a wave of dizziness rolled over him, pulling him back against the pillow. His skin felt tight, almost like parchment stretched over bone, though the dark veins were receding, fading into the pale flesh as if ashamed of their presence.
